claims.evidence: One source per culture (genotype x clone x SILAC round x compartment x time point) and per channel role. MaxQuant experiment names encode round (1/2/2X), compartment (CELLS/MITO), time point (t0/t6/t24), genotype letter (W/H/C) and clone number (1-3). Supp Methods: "Data were obtained in three independent cell clones per genotype in two entirely independent biological replicates corresponding to two rounds of SILAC labeling." Pulsed medium and heavy channels from one lysate are separate sources (precedent PXD028934). Three runs filed as W1-3 are CLPB KO with clone number unconfirmed ("clone-unconfirmed-fileWn"); one run filed as experiment "2CELLS_t0_H" has clone 3 inferred ("clone3-inferred-fileH").

claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC medium / SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: summary.txt: Multiplicity 3, Labels0 empty (light), Labels1 Arg6;Lys4 (medium), Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 (heavy) for all 108 searched runs. Paper: "cultured in medium containing ... light [L] or ... medium [M] ... Then, M-labeled cells were subjected to medium containing ... heavy, H to initiate pulse labeling ... ratios of H/L and M/L reflect different prote[in synthesis and persistence]". Supp: "Pulsed cells were mixed with the same number of light labeled cells". Hence light = unpulsed light-cultured reference cells, medium = pre-existing proteome of pulsed cells, heavy = proteins synthesised during the pulse. PRIDE:0000326/0000327/0000325 verified.

claims.value: wild type / HAX1 knockout / CLPB knockout
claims.evidence: Paper: "PLB-985 cells (WT, HAX1-/-, and CLPB-/-)". Letter code from MaxQuant experiment names, verified on data (genotype_check.txt): H runs have HAX1 Intensity 0 in L, M and H (except anomalies below); C runs have CLPB Intensity 0 in M and H; W runs have both. The light channel carries the same KO as the pulsed cells, so the light reference cells are of the same genotype (consistent with the paper's WT vs HAX1-/- light-LFQ volcano, "n = 18 each, 2 replicates"). 2CELLS_t6_W1/W2/W3 runs: submitter sheet "CLPB ko, not wt"; CLPB = 0 in all channels -> CLPB knockout.

claims.evidence: Experiment names CELLS vs MITO. Supp: "1 x 10^6 heavy-pulsed + light cells were washed with PBS and pelleted ... 3 x 10^6 heavy-pulsed + light cells were further processed for the isolation of mitochondria". Paper: "we isolated either whole cells or mitochondria". GO:0005739 mitochondrion; "cell" (GO cellular component label, as curated precedent PXD070730). Custom characteristics column (batch rule 16).

claims.location: characteristics[sampling time], factor value[sampling time] rows 1-300
claims.evidence: Supp: "At time 0, 6 hours and 24 hours, pulsed cells were collected"; experiment names t0/t6/t24. The value is the heavy-pulse duration of the mix; the light reference rows carry the time point of the mix they were combined into (they were mixed at that time point: "pulsed cells were collected and counted ... mixed with the same number of cells cultured in light medium").

claims.value: (round-1)*3 + clone number (1-6), shared by the three channel rows of one culture
claims.evidence: Supp: three independent clones per genotype x two rounds of SILAC labelling = 6 cultures per genotype; paper: "n = 6 per genotype". Round from the experiment prefix; 2X_ experiments (raw files dated 20180312 on QX0) are round 2: mean M/L correlation to round-2 runs 0.43-0.60 vs -0.17 to -0.56 to round-1 runs (ratio_check.txt); 107/108 experiments match their prefix (2MITO_t24_H1 borderline 0.21 vs 0.25, kept as named). CLPB-KO fileW1/W2/W3 get 4/5/6 in file order (clone kept as unconfirmed in the source name; supporting evidence: in acquisition order they follow t6_H1-3, i.e. the C slot of the W1-3/H1-3/C1-3 order used in every block (acq_order), and their median log2 H/M -2.16/-2.45/-2.24 matches same-mix 2MITO_t6_C1/C2/C3 -2.14/-2.43/-2.28 (hm_check); the Xcalibur timestamp suffix shows files named CELLS_t6_W1-3 already existed, i.e. the real round-2 WT cells-6h runs were not deposited). fileH gets 6 (clone 3) from acquisition order: round-2 cells t0 was acquired W2, W3, H1 (the 2X_ files, 2018-06-13 10:02-14:04), H2 (16:06), H (18:07), C1, C2, C3, so H sits in the H3 slot; HAX1 = 0 confirms the knockout. (The earlier light-intensity clone-signature argument is withdrawn: it groups runs by time point.) 2X_ round 2 is also confirmed by acquisition date: the 7z member times of the three 2X files are 2018-06-13 within the round-2 QX0 sequence, while round-1 QX8 runs date 2018-03-13..18; the 20180312 file prefix is a reused name.

claims.value: 1; 2 for the second run of the same culture (round-2 cells t0 WT clone 3: 2X_t0_W3 then Repeat_t0_W3; HAX1-KO clone 2 cells 24h: t24_H2 then Repeat_t24_H2)
claims.evidence: Only two SILAC rounds exist (supp), and ratio_check assigns the Repeat_ and 2X_ runs to round 2, so a second run of the same genotype/clone/round/compartment/time is a repeat measurement or re-preparation of the same culture, not a new culture. Repeat_t24_H2 vs t24_H2: M/L r=0.75, H/L r=0.80 (highest pair), median log2 H/M -0.20 vs -0.34; Repeat_t0_W3 vs 2X_t0_W3: H/M -2.77 vs -2.88 (both t0 level, same-mix 2MITO_t0_W3 -2.49).

claims.evidence: The raw archive holds 107 .raw files; summary.txt lists 108: 20180312_QX8_MaMu_SA_PBL985_MITO_t0_H1 was searched but its raw file is not in the deposit (not annotated). 20180614_QX0_MaMu_SA_M362_PBL985SILAC_MITO_t6_H1.raw is BLOCKED (sample identity contradicted: HAX1 quantified by MS/MS with 8 peptides at WT-level intensity in L, M and H while clone H1 is HAX1-null in all its other runs). Six round-2 whole-cell raws are BLOCKED because their heavy incorporation contradicts their time point (hm_check): 20180612_..._CELLS_t24_C1/C2/C3/H3 (median log2 H/M -2.78/-2.88/-2.52/-2.69 = t0 level; same-mix 2MITO_t24 runs -0.29/-0.19/-0.74/-0.28) and 20180614_..._CELLS_Repeat_t0_W1/W2 (-0.58/-0.67 = t24 level; same-mix 2MITO_t0_W1/W2 -2.39/-2.45). Remaining 100 annotated; all other 100 runs agree with their time point.
Single-shot runs: supp describes StageTip clean-up and one 100-min gradient per sample, no fractionation; one raw file per MaxQuant experiment.

limitations: Scope: 100 of 107 deposited triple-SILAC raw files annotated (300 rows). BLOCKED (all listed in BLOCKED.md, section PXD023790): (a) 20180614_QX0_MaMu_SA_M362_PBL985SILAC_MITO_t6_H1.raw - labelled HAX1-/- clone H1, but HAX1 is identified by MS/MS (8 peptides) at WT-level intensity in the L, M and H channels while clone H1 has HAX1 = 0 in its other runs; (b) 20180612_QX0_MaMu_SA_M362_PBL985SILAC_CELLS_t24_{C1,C2,C3,H3}.raw and 20180614_QX0_MaMu_SA_M362_PBL985SILAC_CELLS_Repeat_t0_{W1,W2}.raw - median log2 H/M contradicts the labelled pulse time versus the same-mix mitochondria run (t24-labelled at t0 level, t0-labelled at t24 level; hm_check.txt). Consequence: cells/CLPB KO/24 h and cells/WT/6 h have round-1 cultures only. Not deposited: 20180312_QX8_MaMu_SA_PBL985_MITO_t0_H1.raw (in summary.txt, absent from the raw archive).
The HSP27 FLAG-IP raw files (label-free, HEK293T) are in the separate SDRF PXD023790-hsp27-ip.sdrf.tsv (batch rule 12).

comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.6.1.13 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the group-specific first/main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited. The paper/PRIDE text says "initial precursor mass deviation up to 7 ppm", but the same sentence gives a 10 ppm fragment tolerance that the deposited parameters.txt (20 ppm FTMS) contradicts, so that sentence is not used. Consequence: parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 ("Cannot read precursor mass tolerance"); a probe with a filled tolerance converts (18 conditions).

Clone identity of the three CLPB-KO runs filed as 2CELLS_t6_W1/W2/W3 is not documented (submitter note only says "CLPB ko, not wt"); biological replicates 4/5/6 follow file order and source names say clone-unconfirmed.

Clone of experiment "2CELLS_t0_H" (file 20180612_..._CELLS_t0_H.raw) is inferred as clone 3 from the acquisition order (W2, W3, H1, H2, H, C1-C3); it is not stated anywhere. The earlier clone-signature argument is withdrawn (it groups runs by time point).

Light reference cells: the paper says pulsed cells were mixed with "light labeled cells" without naming the clone; the data show the light channel carries the same knockout as the pulsed cells (HAX1/CLPB absent in L), so light rows get the same genotype/clone/round. That the light cells are the same clone (not another clone of the same genotype) is inferred. Exception to disclose: CLPB is detected in the light channel only (1 peptide, 1.3-3.4e9; M = H = 0) in 1MITO_t6_C3, 1MITO_t24_C3 and 2MITO_t24_C3 (genotype_check.txt).
characteristics[cellular component] = cell: the GO label "cell" (GO:0005623) is obsolete in GO and replaced by CL:0000000 "cell"; the label is kept as in 14 curated precedents.

2X_ runs carry a 20180312 file-name date but were acquired on 2018-06-13 in the round-2 QX0 sequence (7z member times, acq_order) and are assigned to round 2 as their experiment prefix says; 2MITO_t24_H1 has a borderline M/L round signature and is kept as named.
Minor HAX1 signal in 1MITO_t6_H2 (2 peptides, ~5% of WT intensity) and 1MITO_t24_H2 (1 peptide) is treated as carry-over/noise; those runs are kept as HAX1 knockout.

characteristics[cell type], passage number, sample storage temperature = not available (not stated; "more than 10 passages in SILAC medium" is not a passage number). Reduction/alkylation reagents not stated (PreOmics LYSE kit), columns omitted; Carbamidomethyl is from the search.
Raw-header verification limited to 4 of 100 annotated SILAC files (techsdrf not installable); dissociation/NCE/scan range assumed uniform.
PRIDE structured fields disagree with the record: instrument "Q Exactive HF" (raw: HF-X); disease "neutropenia" (the cells are a leukemia line); "No PTMs" (search has several).
